name: Close Knit
description: Evidence about neighbourhoods and homes in London and England from official open data: sale prices (HM Land Registry), rents (ONS), crime (police.uk), schools (Ofsted/DfE), flood risk, noise and commute times on TfL timetables. Every answer carries its sources. 24 read-only tools plus send_feedback; free, no sign-in.
author: bmsdave
